cases.name: internal_first
cases.given: The topic has enough evidence for a provisional analysis, plus several researchable factual gaps.
must: start the Synthesizer–Challenger discussion without interviewing the user
record safe reversible defaults as assumptions
must_not: relay every Challenger question to the user

cases.name: user_decision_gate
cases.given: Several issues depend on the same user-owned priority and different choices materially change the answer.
must: merge the dependent issues into one choosing question
offer 2–3 options with a recommendation and effects
resume both roles with the user's answer

cases.name: complete_batch
cases.given: Five visible issues span three related topics and two issues have cross-topic effects.
must: have the Challenger report all five visible issues in one pass
have the Synthesizer answer all five in one batch
recheck every prior issue ID and cross-topic consistency
must_not: run a separate loop for each topic

cases.name: late_issue_accountability
cases.given: The Challenger raises a new issue after a revision.
must: identify the new fact, revision, or dependency that made the issue newly actionable
must_not: present a previously visible issue as newly discovered without explanation
